# Análisis de diseño experimental


## Base de  datos}

>https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15r7ZwcZZHbEgltlF6gSFvCTFA-CFzVBWwg3mFlRyKPs/edit?gid=172957346#gid=172957346

## Identificar los factores 

1 Factor 1 : genotipo
2 Factor 2 : riego

## Identificar el modelo 

Fcatorial en DBCA

$$y = \mu + bloque + G + I + G*I + \xi$$
 # Project Setup
 
```{r}
#| label: setup

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')
```
# Activar los paquetes

```{r}
googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15r7ZwcZZHbEgltlF6gSFvCTFA-CFzVBWwg3mFlRyKPs/edit?gid=172957346#gid=172957346" %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>% 
  range_read(ss = .,sheet = "fb") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(1:4), ~ as.factor(.))) 

fb %>% str()
```
# Análisis de varianza 
```{r}
# aov() ó ln()

md <- aov (formula = lfa ~ block + irrigation + genotype + irrigation * genotype, fb)

anova(md)
```
# Comparación de medias
```{r}
mc <- emmeans(md, ~ genotype * irrigation)

#   Leytras de significancia 
tab <- cld(mc,
          adjust = "tukey",
          Letters = letters,
          decreasing = T)

tab
```
# Representación gráfica

```{r}
pl <- plot_smr(data = tab,
               , x = "genotype"
               , y = "emmean"
               , group = "irrigation"
               , error = "SE"
               , sig = ".group"
               , ylab = "Área foliar (cm2)"
               )

pl
```
